notes: Single-stage: keyword-token rule matching across multiple logs, per-rule match counts and sorted deduped from= IPs, threshold firing, and emission of two exact-schema JSON artifacts (alert.json with timestamp+alerts, report.json with events+statistics). Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (schema assembly + event ordering), adversarial_inputs (malformed rules files, missing fields, empty logs), hidden_case_generalization (three hidden cases), and quantitative_correctness (counts recomputed independently by the verifier).
